body:
Hey friends … my first e-book (a short fiction piece called “The Word of the Lord to Democrats”) is available on amazon here:

 http://www.amazon.com/The-Word-Lord-Democrats-ebook/dp/B007IWW7LS/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1331559066&sr=8-1

It will be available in other (non-kindle) formats soon.

And there’s been a lot of fun conversation going on over on my Facebook page. If you’ve never checked it out, I hope you will … here:

 http://www.facebook.com/pages/Brian-D-McLaren/65814657989?ref=ts
